recognize_zh: CD5染色下，濾泡間區有大量強膜狀陽性的T細胞，中央一個圓形區域（殘存濾泡）染色較淡、只散在少數陽性T細胞，說明結構仍保留、T細胞在濾泡間擴張，符合反應性變化。
features: Numerous CD5-positive small T cells with strong membranous staining in the interfollicular zone
Central rounded area with weak background staining and only scattered positive T cells, consistent with a residual follicle
Preserved compartmentalization of T-cell zones and B-cell follicle
No sheets of CD5-positive large atypical cells
describe_en: Low-to-medium power CD5 immunostain highlights abundant T cells with strong membranous staining in expanded interfollicular zones. A rounded follicle-like area in the center contains only scattered CD5-positive T cells within a weakly stained B-cell compartment. The preserved follicular/interfollicular compartmentalization and absence of aberrant CD5 loss favor a reactive T-cell expansion, as seen in EBV reactivation.

ddx.vs: In these CD5+ B-cell neoplasms the positive cells co-express CD20 and form nodules or diffuse sheets (with cyclin D1 or LEF1), rather than being T cells in the interfollicular zone.
PTCL often shows aberrant loss of CD5 or CD7 in atypical T cells, whereas here CD5 is retained in a reactive-appearing T-cell population.
AITL effaces follicles and shows TFH marker expression with expanded FDC meshworks, whereas a residual follicle is preserved here.
